question: What appearance and ritual power are associated with the golden form?
premises: The form has the splendor of molten gold.
It is a cause of agitation of cities and similar effects.
Appearance and power are linked in this description.
inference: The molten-gold form causes the agitation of cities and similar effects.
plain_english: It has the splendor of molten gold and is the cause of agitating cities and the like.
